name: Milena Petrović
bio:
Milena Petrović's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in her grandfather's auto body shop in Belgrade. There, amidst the clang of tools and the aroma of lacquer, she discovered a passion for the art of vehicle restoration and customization. While she initially focused on classic cars, the vibrant colors and intricate liveries of racing vehicles soon captured her imagination.

She transitioned to motorsport by working with a local rally team, quickly gaining a reputation for her meticulous attention to detail and innovative paint solutions. Her expertise extends beyond mere application; Milena possesses a deep understanding of paint chemistry and aerodynamics, allowing her to optimize paint finishes for both aesthetics and performance. She approaches every project as an opportunity to push the boundaries of paint technology and design, creating visually stunning and aerodynamically efficient results.

What sets Milena apart is her ability to anticipate future trends in paint technology and design. She's constantly experimenting with new materials and techniques, ensuring her team remains at the forefront of the industry. Her leadership style is characterized by a collaborative approach, fostering a creative environment where innovation thrives. She believes that the paint shop is not just a place to apply color, but a crucial element in the overall performance and branding of a racing team.

physical.description: Milena has a warm smile and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always wears a pair of bright red work boots, regardless of the dress code.
Insists on using a specific type of Serbian folk music to inspire creativity in the paint shop.
Keeps a detailed notebook filled with sketches and ideas for future paint schemes.
